# Azure policy

Staging only; production is forbidden. F11 proves subscription, region, quota, Search, Foundry model, budget, policy, and OIDC readiness before provisioning. Protected manual workflows pin an approved default-branch SHA and use OIDC. The run gets one uniquely named RG with run/owner/repository/TTL tags and an RG-scoped deployment identity. Defaults are TTL 4h, Azure estimate $20, Actions 240 minutes, and Copilot 40 premium requests; policy may lower but not silently raise them. Public endpoints are temporary.

Cleanup inventories the exact RG before deletion. It allows one lifecycle-exception type: `Microsoft.CognitiveServices/accounts`, needed by the Foundry deployment. Each account is predeclared by exact name, location, and resource group. After deleting the RG, a dedicated narrow purge identity may invoke only the Cognitive Services deleted-account purge operation for those declarations. A separate subscription-read identity lists deleted accounts and proves none of the declarations remain. Other soft-delete resource types fail before deletion until a reviewed exact purge-and-read-back policy is added. Cleanup never enumerates resources as deletion targets or broadens scope after failure.
